meta_data.base_class: retrieve details of discoveries within a given <academic discipline> - each discipline represents an independent knowledge system.

tool_template.name: get_<class>_discovery_details
tool_template.description: Retrieve the details of a <class> discovery based on the discovery name.

method_used.description: The method used for the <class> discovery, e.g., experimental, observational, theoretical.

discoverer.description: The person or team who made the <class> discovery.

related_publications.description: A list of publications related to the <class> discovery.

detail_level.description: Specifies how detailed the returned information about the <class> discovery should be, being 'summary', 'standard', or 'comprehensive'.

include_follow_up_discoveries.description: If true, include information on subsequent <class> discoveries influenced by this one.
